limit.description: Maximum returned matches. Omission uses the handler's limit of 10.

query.description: Text to find within a project name; empty searches are rejected.

inputSchema.description: Case-insensitive search over the project names explicitly supplied by the host.

projects.description: Names within the selected host context. No project metadata is fetched.

outputSchema.description: Matching names in the host's original order; an empty list is a successful search.

documentation.description: Find projects in the selected workspace without fetching additional context.
documentation.title: Find projects
documentation.resultDescription: Matching project names, capped by the requested limit.
